from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class MonthlyHousingData(BaseModel):
    """A single month's housing starts data extracted from one report."""
    month: str | None = Field(description="The month covered by this record (YYYY-MM)")
    total_saar: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate for Total Housing Starts")
    single_family_saar: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate for Single-Family Housing Starts")
    report_release_date: str | None = Field(description="Release date of the report (YYYY-MM-DD), used to resolve conflicting values per precedence rule")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    housing_records: list[MonthlyHousingData]
